t: Increased the maximum allowed length from 255 to 4,096 characters to support longer access tokens.
Increased the maximum allowed length of the oauthToken parameter in the CreateApp and UpdateApp APIs to support longer OAuth tokens issued by third-party Git providers.
Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
Update documentation for cacheConfig in CreateApp API
Add support for customizable build instance sizes. CreateApp and UpdateApp operations now accept a new JobConfig parameter composed of BuildComputeType.
Added appId field to Webhook responses
Introduced support for Skew Protection. Added enableSkewProtection field to createBranch and updateBranch API.
Add ComputeRoleArn to CreateApp, UpdateApp, CreateBranch, and UpdateBranch, allowing caller to specify a role to be assumed by Amplify Hosting for server-side rendered applications.
Added WAF Configuration to Amplify Apps
Added sourceUrlType field to StartDeployment request
Doc only update to Amplify to explain platform setting for Next.js 14 SSG only applications
Add a new field "cacheConfig" that enables users to configure the CDN cache settings for an App
This doc-only update identifies fields that are specific to Gen 1 and Gen 2 applications.
Updating max results limit for listing any resources (Job, Artifacts, Branch, BackendResources, DomainAssociation) to 50 with the exception of list apps that where max results can be up to 100.
Documentation updates for Amplify. Identifies the APIs available only to apps created using Amplify Gen 1.
This release contains API changes that enable users to configure their Amplify domains with their own custom SSL/TLS certificate.
Add backend field to CreateBranch and UpdateBranch requests. Add pagination support for ListApps, ListDomainAssociations, ListBranches, and ListJobs
Adds a new value (WEB_COMPUTE) to the Platform enum that allows customers to create Amplify Apps with Server-Side Rendering support.
Documentation only update to support the Amplify GitHub App feature launch
Add repositoryCloneMethod field for hosting an Amplify app. This field shows what authorization method is used to clone the repo: SSH, TOKEN, or SIGV4.
Doc only update to the description of basicauthcredentials to describe the required encoding and format.
